turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Ms. Hale, or is it Mr.? Either way, I have about twenty minutes and a client call after that. Why was my son's mark changed to zero before anyone called me?
I'm sure. You didn't answer my question, though. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
I admire how you fight for your kids. I'd have wanted a mom like you.
Don't manage me, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and was my son heard before it was entered?
We really want the same thing here, you and me. We're on the same team.
Then why did my son find out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of class? I've asked you twice who decided and whether he was heard first, Hale. I'm still waiting.
So as teammates, can we just move forward?

We're not teammates. You're the person who entered a zero against my son. I'm writing down that you've now avoided the question three times, so answer it: was Owen spoken to before that mark went in, yes or no?
